entries.name: Hindsight
entries.agent_os_overlap: Context compiler matcher over Git JSON memory records; no rank fusion of lexical, tag and recency signals.

algorithms: fusion of semantic, BM25, graph and temporal recall arms

risks.claims: LongMemEval numbers are vendor or co-author measured

evidence.quality: vendor-reported LongMemEval 83.6-94.6%; reproduction is by paper co-authors; no arm ablation seen
evidence.security: Postgres service would hold private memory
evidence.complexity: service plus database if adopted; stdlib fusion is small

entries.rationale: Headline accuracy is vendor-measured and the server would be a second memory authority. A stdlib rank-fusion experiment in the context matcher is cheap but needs a recall@k fixture first.
provenance: web search found no r/OpenSourceAI thread
revisit_when: a recall@k fixture for context compile exists

entries.name: Cognee
entries.agent_os_overlap: Knowledge library and profile facts are already structured Git JSON with provenance; no LLM graph extraction.

evidence.runtime_savings: none; adds LLM calls at ingest
evidence.quality: vendor benchmark: 24 HotPotQA questions, LLM judge; no independent evaluation
evidence.security: graph and vector stores would hold private data
evidence.complexity: graph database plus vector store plus LLM extraction

entries.rationale: LLM graph extraction and a database duplicate the Git-backed store, and the benchmark evidence is vendor-only on an unrelated task.
provenance: web search found no r/OpenSourceAI thread
revisit_when: cross-record questions the context compiler cannot answer become a FAIL

entries.name: ACON
entries.agent_os_overlap: Retry prompts quote failing test output; handoff templates are hand-written; history lives in the CLI.

algorithms: optimize an instruction from cases where full context succeeds and compressed context fails

risks.fit: history compression has no hook in Claude Code or Codex adapters

evidence.runtime_savings: paper reports 26-54% peak tokens; peak tokens are not cost under 1-hour cache pricing
evidence.quality: authors' own results on AppWorld, OfficeBench, QA; not coding agents; no reproduction found
evidence.reliability: our replay: lossy reduction removed later-used text in 28-47% of results
evidence.complexity: research framework needing AppWorld data and an OpenAI key

entries.rationale: History compression has no hook in our architecture and loses on measured cache economics; the contrastive guideline-tuning loop may help handoff and retry templates later.
provenance: web search found no r/OpenSourceAI thread
revisit_when: Agent OS gains its own agent loop
retry or handoff template tuning becomes a goal

entries.name: Focus (Active Context Compression)
entries.agent_os_overlap: Agent OS does not own the agent loop; history is inside Claude Code or Codex.

risks.evidence: five SWE-bench Lite instances, one model

evidence.runtime_savings: paper: 22.7% fewer total tokens; ignores cache pricing, and our trimming test cost 2-6% more than it saved
evidence.quality: 3/5 vs 3/5 accuracy on five tasks; cannot show parity
evidence.reliability: paper notes overhead can exceed benefit on iterative work

entries.rationale: No code exists to audit and the evidence is five tasks; only an offline cache-priced model of drop-after-checkpoint is worth running, and it is expected to kill the idea.
provenance: arXiv 2601.07190 and hyper.ai mirrors via web search (2026-10-17)
searched for author, start_focus, complete_focus plus github: no repository found
revisit_when: Agent OS gains its own agent loop

entries.name: Agent-Reach
entries.agent_os_overlap: Workers already have web access through the coding CLI; no capability preflight doctor command for adapters.

workflows: doctor command: per-capability health check with fix hint

evidence.quality: no benchmark; depends on scraping that platforms can break
evidence.reliability: primary plus fallback routing visible in code; unmeasured
evidence.security: needs cookies or a logged-in browser for several platforms

entries.rationale: Scraping glue with credential exposure and unrelated to memory or context; only the doctor-style preflight pattern is worth noting.
provenance: web search found no r/OpenSourceAI thread
revisit_when: a worker task needs a platform the CLI cannot reach
